Associated Keywords: surfer seo review, content optimization tools, ai visibility tracking, surfer pricing
Entity: Surfer SEO / Content Optimization and AI Visibility
Friction: Surfer sells AI-visibility prompt tracking twice — bundled into its content plans and as a standalone analytics product — and the standalone is dramatically cheaper per prompt. Its $95 standalone plan tracks 50 prompts; its $119 Standard content plan tracks 25. Shoppers comparing Surfer against alternatives compare the content plans, so anyone switching because of prompt tracking is benchmarking the most expensive way Surfer sells it.
Logic: Decide which of the two products you are actually replacing before comparing anything. If it is prompt tracking, the honest Surfer baseline is its standalone plan at $1.85 per prompt, not the $4.76 buried in Standard — and against that baseline Frase ($0.60-$0.98) and Clearscope Business ($1.33) still undercut it while Scalenut Starter ($5.90) does not. If it is the content editor, the comparables are NeuronWriter from $23, Scalenut from $59 and Clearscope from $129, and Surfer's own entry tier is Discovery at $59 with no prompt tracking at all. The refresh cadence is the axis most comparisons miss: Standard refreshes weekly, Pro and above daily, and a weekly number is not the same measurement as a daily one. We are not an alternative: audit-only, no generation, no tracking.
content_angle: Surfer prices the same feature two ways and the cheaper way is the one nobody benchmarks — $95 standalone buys twice the prompts of the $119 content plan. The piece normalizes per-prompt rates across both Surfer products and four competitors, flags the annual-default display and the 360-documents-per-year framing as reading traps, and is explicit that the bundled premium buys content tooling rather than tracking. Names our own position: audit-only.
author: Marcus Orion
